title: AIAS Normative Access and External Assessment Readiness
purpose: Prepare lawful standards acquisition, certification scope and independent-provider evaluation without authorizing commercial action.
scope: Normative asset registry, copyright boundary, certification scope, provider competence, independence, RFP and human authorization gates.

requirements.title: Legitimate access
requirements.statement: AIAS shall inventory required normative assets and acquire them only through authorized channels.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Certification scope
requirements.statement: AIAS shall maintain a draft scope with explicit exclusions and external scoping gates.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Provider competence
requirements.statement: Candidates shall have independently verifiable authority and framework-specific competence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Independence
requirements.statement: Provider evaluation shall require independence and conflict disclosure.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Human authorization
requirements.statement: No purchase, outreach, selection, contract or certification claim shall occur without explicit authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible readiness
requirements.statement: The capability shall include SDD, tests, documentation, installer, reference state and checksum release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
